_: The flash plays of the year (flash-plays.html, written by tools/pages/build.mjs: npm run pages). Each play: its own key (small letters, digits and -), its title (and a line under it, sub), where it is performed (at), who it is made with (with), its dates written YYYY-MM-DD (none while they are to be announced; every date is shown as tentative), and the key of its event in content/gallery.json where it has pictures (gallery). The countdown beside the calendar is to the play named in countdown, on its next date (once it has none to come, to the next play); without countdown, to the next play.
